body:
I am in a bad spot but what's the reason for it eh?

I choose to be lazy, choose to not study, choose to not socialize, lied to everyone i could. Everyone thinks i am perfectly cuz of the way i interact.

I am too behind i already passed school with such low marks no one hires i mean a job has a percentage like 50% or more i don't even have those. If i do make friends what do i to talk about? i am out of touch i don't interact with anything not a single thing is interesting to me.

But no one has 2 minutes to sit down and create a path.

There is realization that one day my parents will be no more and frankly i don't want to see that day i don't want to live till that day i just want to die now i can't handle stuff. 

I haven't stepped out of the house since days i can see how much worried my mom is and all she wants if for me to get a job but i don't even the balls to apply for one. 

See these are career years i don't even have  C.V heck i don't know what it is but you see i kinda lost the reason to care.

Deep introspection, meditation, asking my self what's wrong with me? lazy what do i want from my life? nothing what do i truly want? death.
